reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel sanctions-aml rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary. KYE already governs AML / sanctions-screening / SAR-filing / PEP via kye:rule-pack:aml-financial-crimes + kye:sector-pack:aml-financial-crimes + kye:dictionary:aml-financial-crimes (rules incl. the SAR/STR §36 two-person sign-off gate), bound to FATF-40 / EU 6AMLD / US BSA-FinCEN / Wolfsberg. A parallel pack is a §0 violation; re-mapping those frameworks is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the Sanctions & AML Authority Agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:sector-pack:aml-financial-crimes flow under KYE authority (the runtime-kye-chargeback-evidence-agent pattern). Add only the agent-product artefacts (governed-agents dictionary, §52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing FATF-40 / EU 6AMLD / US BSA-FinCEN / Wolfsberg frameworks.
